messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Confusion on glimmer.rstudio and new Shiny Server
parts: I'm a little confused on the Shiny Server.  I believe it is used for hosting a Shiny app on any server.  I currently host an app on glimmer.rstudio and would like to keep it there, what changes do I have to make (if any)?   Can the Server package be used to upload apps to glimmer.rstudio?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Confusion on glimmer.rstudio and new Shiny Server
parts:
Shiny Server is if you want to use your own server instead of hosting it on ours (glimmer). This is really important to a lot of folks who can't let their code or data out of their organization, or want more computational/storage resources than we can offer, or need their apps to access their internal network, etc. If you're happy on glimmer you don't have to make any changes.

Thanks!
